The '''Yankirk system''' was located within the [[Ado sector/Legends|Ado sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the [[Yankirk Route]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]].<ref name="Lords">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Yankirk [[Star system/Legends|system]] was established in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed the system in grid square L-17.<ref name="TEA" />
